reflection.error_reason: A geometric sequence with first term $a$ and common ratio $r$ has the form $a_n = a r^{n-1}$, not $a_n = r^n$. This step also contradicts $a_1=a$ unless $a=r$, so it does not represent a general geometric sequence.
